notes:
First public release.

Notes, tasks and a real zsh terminal over a plain folder of markdown files.
Kanban and table views over `type: task` frontmatter, a live-preview markdown
editor with wikilinks and backlinks, multi-language code editing, HTML preview,
and an MCP server that lets Claude Code drive the app.

macOS 12 or later, Apple Silicon only. The first install needs one extra step
to get past Gatekeeper — see the download page.
